guidance.message: New function components can accept ref as a prop.
Consider useActionState and useOptimistic for action results and pending UI.
Use useEffectEvent for non-reactive logic called from Effects; preserve genuine reactive dependencies.
Consider ViewTransition for transition animations when browser support is suitable.
Fragment refs can address grouped DOM children without adding a wrapper.
